delete_bad_secret.why: delete.php used $config before loading it: on servers that display PHP notices, the JSON was prefixed with an HTML notice. The response is now plain JSON (same status and content).

error.message: Token : TOKA0008 and/or secretid : WRONG do not exist.

delete_ok.why: Same as delete_bad_secret: plain JSON without the PHP notice.
